name: Image
summary: A bitmap in a box: an img element with a shape, an optional border and shadow, and a fit rule for how the source fills the box. Use it for pictures and logos; an Avatar draws a person, a Skeleton a placeholder.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: The image source; the native img attribute.

inputs.name: alt
inputs.description: The alternative text; an empty string marks a decorative image.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: square has no rounding, rounded borderRadiusMedium, circular borderRadiusCircular.

inputs.name: fit
inputs.description: How the source fills the box: default leaves the native sizing; none draws it at natural size from the top left; center at natural size centred; contain scaled to fit centred; cover scaled to fill centred.

inputs.name: block
inputs.description: The image takes the full width of its container.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: An explicit width in px; with height, sizes the box.

anatomy.name: Image
anatomy.description: The img element, inline-block with border-box sizing, its border colour Stroke 1 whether or not a border is drawn.

variants.description: borderRadiusCircular, a circle when the box is square.
No object-fit rule; the box is the source's size unless width or height say otherwise.
object-fit none from the left top: the source at natural size, clipped from the top-left corner.
object-fit none centred: the source at natural size, clipped around the centre.
Scaled down or up to fit inside the box, centred, keeping its ratio.
Scaled to cover the box, centred, keeping its ratio and clipping the rest.

layout.text: The root is inline-block, border-box, with Stroke 1 as its border colour and no radius; bordered gives it a strokeWidthThin solid border, shadow gives it shadow4.
Any fit but default with no explicit width or height makes the element 100% of its container in both axes, so the fit rule has a box to work against; with a width or height the element is that size.
block sets the width to 100% of the container.

states.text: An image has no interaction states.

behaviour.text: Nothing animates; the browser's image loading applies.

semantics: alt text names the image, or an empty alt hides a decorative one from assistive technology

notes.text: The border colour is set on the base even when bordered is false; only the border style and width are conditional, so a renderer must not draw a stroke unless bordered.
A renderer without bitmap decoding cannot draw the image itself; the box, border, radius and shadow are still specified and a placeholder fill in the parent's surface colour is the honest stand-in.
